styleguide.title: AgriLedger style sample
styleguide.eyebrow: Team 05 · Theme 04 · Draft for team review
styleguide.note_1: All amounts and names on these boards are sample data for layout only.
styleguide.note_2: Quintal is the default unit; kg is one tap away.

type.label: Type
type.body: Noto Sans for everything you read and fill in. Source Serif 4 for headings and the AgriLedger name. A Noto Sans Kannada file can be added later without changing the design.
type.figures: Numbers use tabular figures, so columns line up like a ledger book.

status.label: Status: one colour family, words do the work
status.note: Green means healthy. Grey means waiting or finished. Red appears only when something is wrong, and always with an icon and words.

photo.note: Photo slots are hatched boxes on these wireframes. Real lot photos replace them; the Pool Manager uploads 1 to 3 per pool.
